_doc: Hooks pra sessao Claude Code / Antigravity no Forum Ambicao 2030 - adaptado pra bun + TanStack Start. Symlinks hooks/ commands/ get-shit-done/ apontam para antigravity_system_core/.

hooks.command: FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_OUTPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.tsx?$'; then bun typecheck 2>&1 | tail -10; fi; exit 0
FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_OUTPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$'; then bun x eslint --fix "$FILE" --max-warnings=0 2>&1 | tail -5 || true; fi; exit 0
echo '[Stop] Verificacao final...' && bun typecheck 2>&1 | grep -E '(error TS|Found [0-9]+ error)' | head -10 || echo '[Stop] TypeScript OK'; exit 0
hooks.description: TypeScript check completo - site publico, gates rigorosos
